layers.name: Sound-wave disc
layers.paint: Perfectly concentric circular sound-wave rings centered in the disc, radiating outward from a small bright glowing lavender-white core, five evenly spaced smooth rounded bands alternating rich violet, orchid pink and deep indigo purple, darkest at the rim, saturated and luminous like a voice made visible, symmetrical, glossy soft gradients, no text
